The name represents the beaver's innate creativity and resourcefulness in building and designing structures that ensure their survival. This name can serve as a reminder to be like the beaver, building a strong and secure foundation for our spiritual lives, and utilizing our God-given talents to create a better world for ourselves and others. The name Beverley can also represent the clearing or still place within our souls, where we can connect with God and find inner peace.
